Voting onchain

A decentralized governance process where votes on protocol decisions are cast and recorded directly on the blockchain, ensuring transparency and tamper resistance.

Definition

A decentralized governance process where votes on protocol decisions are cast and recorded directly on the blockchain, ensuring transparency and tamper resistance.

Operational example

Onchain voting enables portfolio holders to transparently participate in protocol upgrades, fee changes, and treasury allocations.
